synopsis: Government Gazette No. 47790, Notice 2908 brought South African Mine Health and Safety sub-regulations 8.10.1.2(b) and 8.10.2.1(b) into effect on 21 December 2022, consistently reported across Chapters 2 and 3 and the glossary [f1363, f2078, f15555, f2273, f2791]. Chapter 2 and the glossary distinguish their publication or promulgation on 27 February 2015 from their later commencement, with no transitional period [f1363, f15555]. The provisions cover underground trackless mobile machine-to-pedestrian risk and machine-to-machine risk, with Chapter 3 specifying significant collision risk for the latter [f15555, f2273]. The supplied facts agree on the commencement date and instrument; they do not describe detailed compliance or acceptance requirements [f1363, f2078, f15555, f2273, f2791].
